## Why this name

- Clamps x>0xEF and y>0x9F to 0 (GBA screen bounds 240x160) then stores the pair at Unk0798 +0x90/+0x92
- Callers pass y as a row stride (0x40, 0x50, 0x60...) with x=0, then call TextDrawAlign which derives x from measured width
